results.rule_description: Hole depth-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 10:1 for standard drills
results.observation: No holes are present in the part geometry.

results.rule_description: Tapped hole thread depth >= 1.5x nominal bolt diameter
results.observation: No threaded holes are present in the part.

results.rule_description: Minimum internal bore diameter >= 3mm for standard boring bars
results.observation: The internal diameter of the ring is significantly larger than 3mm.

results.rule_description: Length-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 8:1 to avoid deflection
results.observation: The part is a thin ring; its axial length is much smaller than its diameter, well within the 8:1 ratio.

results.rule_description: Internal features must be accessible from one end of the workpiece
results.observation: The part is a simple ring with no internal enclosed features or grooves.

results.rule_description: Groove width >= 3mm for standard grooving/parting tools
results.observation: There are no grooves on the part.

results.rule_description: All features must have adequate clearance for manufacturing tool access
results.observation: All surfaces of the simple ring geometry are easily accessible for machining.

results.rule_description: Prefer symmetric features to reduce setup operations and fixturing complexity
results.observation: The part is symmetric except for the functional slit required for a piston ring.

results.rule_description: Horizontal holes should use a teardrop profile to prevent sagging at the top of the hole.
results.observation: No horizontal holes are present.

results.rule_description: Functional protrusions attached to thin walls should have fillets or ribs to distribute stress and prevent layer delamination.
results.observation: No protrusions are attached to the part.

results.rule_description: Lids and mating enclosures should have alignment features such as a lip, flange, or pins to ensure proper registration.
results.observation: The part is not a lid or enclosure.

results.rule_description: Sharp internal corners should be filleted to reduce stress concentrations and prevent cracking.
results.observation: There are no internal pockets or cutouts with sharp corners (the slit is a through-cut).

results.rule_description: Hinge knuckles must have rounded profiles concentric with the pivot pin to allow rotation without collision.
results.observation: No hinge knuckles are present.

results.rule_description: Lids and doors should have a handle, tab, or indentation to facilitate user opening.
results.observation: The part is not a lid or door.

results.rule_description: Sharp external edges should be chamfered or filleted for handling safety and to reduce chipping.
results.observation: The inner and outer edges of the ring, as well as the edges at the slit, appear perfectly sharp (90 degrees) without any chamfers or fillets.
results.recommendation: Add small chamfers or fillets to the external edges to prevent stress concentrations and improve handling safety.

results.rule_description: Internal vertical corners must have a minimum radius to accommodate the cylindrical shape of an end mill.
results.observation: There are no internal vertical corners in pockets.

results.rule_description: Holes intended for pin or shaft insertion should have a chamfered lead-in to facilitate assembly.
results.observation: No holes for pin insertion are present.

results.rule_description: Turned parts should be rotationally symmetric; non-symmetric features require secondary milling operations.
results.observation: The ring features a slit (gap), making it non-rotationally symmetric.
results.recommendation: Acknowledge that a secondary slitting operation (e.g., using a slitting saw or wire EDM) will be required after the primary turning operation.

results.rule_description: Cylindrical pins intended for floating assembly should have retaining ring grooves or other axial retention features.
results.observation: The part is not a cylindrical pin.

results.rule_description: Closed-loop bearing holes intended for assembly over captive shafts must be split into two pieces with fastening features.
results.observation: The part is a split ring, not a closed-loop bearing hole.

results.rule_description: Pistons must have circumferential ring grooves for sealing.
results.observation: The part is a piston ring, not a piston.

proposed_rules.description: Thin-walled turned parts should have sufficient thickness to prevent deformation during machining.
proposed_rules.pass_criteria: Wall thickness is sufficient to withstand chucking and cutting forces.
proposed_rules.fail_criteria: Extremely thin walls that may crush in a chuck or deflect away from the cutting tool.
proposed_rules.look_for: Very thin radial or axial sections on turned parts.
